reviewer.actual_effort: low: one look at each of the 14 crops before opening review.json. No full native scans opened, and no pixel measurement. Three wide crops (av-jerusalem, berikh-points, lehar) were shown to me at about 0.46x, so their native-4x detail was partly lost. The other crops were shown at about 1.0-1.2x.

marks.batachnu: Under the word I see two qamatz shapes, one vertical stroke and one sheva. I cannot tell whether the vertical stroke belongs to tet (meteg) or to another letter
marks.melekh_mem: segol. I see no clear vertical stroke under the mem (low confidence)

unresolved: Whether ט in בטחנו has a meteg: cannot decide. I do not confirm 'NO'
Whether מ in מלך has a meteg: tentatively no
Which letter the Jerusalem vertical stroke belongs to

marks.arukhim_resh: The resh looks damaged: its head prints as a separate horizontal stroke

unresolved: Whether the stroke is a vav or a yod: leaning וְטוֹבִים. A blemish is unlikely because of the sheva under it
